LET'S CLEAR THE AIR
Got Questions? We've Got Answers
How often should I service my system?
−

Once a year per system — cooling in spring, heating in fall. Regular tune-ups protect efficiency, prevent breakdowns, and keep manufacturer warranties valid. Maintenance plan members get both visits scheduled automatically, plus priority service between them.

Do you handle commercial properties?
+

Every week. Rooftop units, PTAC programs, commercial heating, and maintenance plans for offices, restaurants, retail, and managed portfolios across the service area — with work scheduled around your business hours and every proposal written and itemized.

What does an estimate cost?
+

Nothing. A licensed technician visits your home or building, assesses the system, and hands you a written, itemized quote — free, with no obligation.

How fast can you get here?
+

Same-day and next-day service covers most of our core counties — Passaic, Bergen, Essex, Morris, and Hudson — and no-heat or no-cooling calls move to the front of the line. We also schedule residential and commercial work across New York City, the lower Hudson Valley, and the rest of North Jersey. Our trucks dispatch from Clifton, so most of the core area is under thirty minutes away.

Do you guarantee your work?
+

Yes — Pacific Air stands behind every job with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. We're licensed and insured in New Jersey, our technicians are EPA-certified, and we pull permits on every job that requires one, so the town's inspection backs up our own.

Do you work in New York City and the Hudson Valley?
+

Yes. We schedule installations, commercial projects, and maintenance across the five boroughs and in Westchester and Rockland counties, in addition to our North Jersey core. Clifton sits fifteen miles from Manhattan, and our commercial crews cross the river regularly. Same-day response remains a core-county service.

Where is Pacific Air HVAC located and what are your hours?
+

Our shop is at 16 Orono St, Clifton, NJ 07013. We are open Monday through Saturday, 8AM to 5PM, and closed Sunday. Call (973) 210-7060 or request a quote online, and trucks dispatch daily from Clifton to Passaic, Bergen, Essex, Morris, and Hudson counties.

Is the estimate actually free?

Do I need to be at the property for the visit?
+

For most residential work, yes — the technician needs interior access and your answers about how the home behaves. For commercial and managed properties, we coordinate access with a superintendent or manager when the owner cannot attend.

ABOUT PACIFIC AIR HVAC
A family-owned HVAC contractor, serving North Jersey since 2009.

Pacific Air HVAC installs, repairs, and maintains heating, cooling, and air quality systems for homes and businesses across Passaic, Bergen, Essex, Morris, and Hudson counties.

OUR HISTORY
The company began with one van and a trade.

Founded in Clifton. Family-owned and family-operated today.

Pacific Air HVAC was founded in Clifton in 2009 by Ali, who started the company with a single 1994 Ford Econoline van and a background in sheet metal work. The early years were spent on residential service calls throughout Passaic County, and the company's reputation was built on the quality of completed work.

The company has since grown to a fleet of six trucks and a team of more than thirty technicians, fabricators, and office staff. That growth has been deliberate. Each expansion of the service area followed demand from existing customers, and each new team member is trained to the standards set on the company's first jobs.

Pacific Air remains family-owned and family-operated, and the practices established at the beginning have not changed. Ductwork is fabricated in our own shop. Permits are filed for every job that requires them. Pricing is provided in writing before work begins.

WHAT WE VALUE
Three principles guide how we operate.

They apply to every job, residential and commercial.

01
Professionalism

Technicians arrive on schedule, in uniform, and prepared for the work. Job sites are protected while work is underway and cleaned before we leave.

02
Reliability

Commitments are kept. Appointment windows, project timelines, and written quotes are treated as obligations, and we communicate promptly when conditions change.

03
Care

Recommendations are based on what the building requires. When a repair is sufficient, a repair is what we recommend.

IN-HOUSE FABRICATION
Sheet metal fabrication, performed in our own shop.

Most HVAC contractors order ductwork from third-party fabricators. Pacific Air operates its own sheet metal shop in Clifton, where every duct, transition, and plenum we install is measured, cut, and formed by our own staff.

Fabricating in-house allows ductwork to be built to the exact dimensions of each building rather than adapted from standard sizes. It also removes outside lead times from project schedules, which keeps installations on the dates we commit to.

LICENSING & CERTIFICATIONS
Credentials, documented.

Documentation is available on request.

NJ Master HVACR License

Licensed and insured in the State of New Jersey. Lic. #19HC00622600.

EPA Section 608

All technicians who handle refrigerants hold current EPA certification.

Mitsubishi Electric

Certified installer of Mitsubishi Electric ductless systems.

Fujitsu

Certified installer of Fujitsu ductless systems.

The Unico System

Certified installer of high-velocity systems for homes without conventional ductwork.

Municipal Permits

Permits are filed for all qualifying work, and installations are inspected by the municipality.

WHO WE SERVE
Residential and commercial work, to the same standard.

The same technicians, documentation, and pricing practices apply to both.

Residential

Work ranges from single-room ductless installations to complete system replacements, including boiler service for older housing and high-velocity systems for homes without existing ductwork.

Commercial

Rooftop units, PTAC programs, commercial heating, and scheduled maintenance plans for offices, restaurants, retail locations, and managed properties, with service records documented for every unit.

CONTACT
Request an estimate or ask a question.

Estimates are provided at no cost and include a written, itemized quote. A member of our Clifton office responds within one business day.
